description:
Returns currently trending stocks that recently received analyst ratings.

    Returns: ticker, SmartScore, analyst/blogger sentiment, hedge fund trend,
             price target, buy/hold/sell counts per stock.

daysAgo.description: Days to look back: 3, 7, or any number from 30 up — anything else (1, 2, 14…) is rejected. Default 7. Use 30 or more when filtering by sector or country, as narrow windows often return very few stocks.
daysAgo.title: Daysago

filter.description: Exactly one of 'analysts', 'bloggers' or 'both' (default: analysts). Any other value is rejected rather than answered.
filter.title: Filter

num.description: How many trending stocks to return (default 20). Set it to the count the user asks for.
num.title: Num

sector.description: Sector filter: energy, financial, general, healthcare, industrials, services, technology or utilities. Omit for all sectors; a sector outside this list is refused rather than answered. Rows for sector='energy' are energy companies even though the feed labels them UTILITIES.
sector.title: Sector

trendingType.description: Exactly 'best-rated' or 'worst-rated'; omit for all (default). Any other value is rejected rather than silently returning the unranked list.
trendingType.title: Trendingtype

name: get_trending_stocks
